name: Bible
about: Russian Synodal translation, daily readings by plan
trHint: MyBible modules are .SQLite3 files (published on MyBible module sites). The 66 canonical books are used; commentaries and dictionaries are not needed. The module is stored only on this device. Psalm numbering follows the module.
trDelText: The module file will be removed from the device; reading marks stay.
trNotSaved: The module was not saved: not enough space
trNotBible: This is not a Bible module (no verses table)
trNoBooks: The module has no canonical books
help.what: The Synodal translation and daily readings by plan.
help.1: Book and chapter — the title button; Testaments are tabs.
help.2: “Read” at the chapter end marks the plan and home.
help.3: A ready or custom plan: “Modules and features” → “Church mode”.
help.tip: A missed day does not burn — the rhythm is weekly.
modDelText: The module file will be removed from the device.
trHintStudy: MyBible modules are .SQLite3 files: translations, dictionaries (including Strong's lexicons), commentaries, footnotes, cross-references, subheadings. Stored only on this device. Gestures as in MyBible: double tap on a word or Strong's number — lexicon entry; tap a mark — commentary (◆), references (↗) or footnote; long press on a verse — verse menu; swipe — next or previous chapter; pinch — font size.
st.noLex: No Strong's lexicon — add a module under «Translation»
st.noDict: No dictionaries — add a module under «Translation»
st.noCommMod: No commentaries — add a module under «Translation»
st.noFoot: Footnote not found: no footnote module for this translation
st.noBook: This book is not in the translation
